description: This file declares a logging interface within the SAP namespace, including log level enums, initialization, macros for logging at various levels, and utility functions related to logging.

methods.name: methodName
methods.description: Returns the method name given a pretty function string.

methods.name: logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the logging system; should be called once before logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, with context info like function, file, line, thread ID.
